name: Soitec SA
blurb: Soitec SA develops and manufactures semiconductor materials, specializing in silicon-on-insulator (SOI) substrates. The company serves markets including mobile communications, automotive, and 5G infrastructure. It is headquartered in France and listed on Euronext Paris under the ticker SOI.
recent: Over the past month, Soitec's stock price surged more than 10% on May 8, 2026, reaching €167.20. The company's market cap stands at €5.38 billion, with revenue of €783.86 million and net income of €11.33 million for the trailing twelve months.
